Asobi Review 1.0 (build 1576) Oct 14, 2026

  • Pull Plates leaves other people’s plates alone. A version folder another tool wrote (a vfx edit publish) is no longer taken for an unfinished pull of Asobi’s: the pull writes the next version beside it.
  • Pull Again and Write over. A plate left alone because it is already on disk can be pulled again from its row. “Write over the version on disk” puts a fixed plate back on its newest version instead of making another; Asobi lists the versions and asks first.
  • Frames to check say which. A pulled plate’s check names the frames and what is wrong with them (“1023 repeated”).
  • What a pull is waiting for. After the last frame, the Queue says “Waiting to finish” and “Checking its frames” instead of looking stuck.
  • Shot names follow the prefix. Typing another shot-name prefix in Pull Plates renames the shots; names a cut was given under another prefix (a pull made with the wrong one) no longer stick. Opening the window again plans the cut afresh.
  • Windows stay behind other apps. A panel left at the floating level while another app was in front (Pull Plates over DaVinci Resolve) is lowered with the rest.
Earlier updates

1.0 (build 1476) Oct 12, 2026

  • DPX sequences play. 8, 10, 12 and 16-bit DPX files open and play like any other image sequence, read as the color space set for DPX in Settings, Color.
  • A tall floating Playlist with thumbnails could stop the app. Fixed.
  • Small fixes.

1.0 (build 1441) Oct 11, 2026

  • Network is in the Review menu. Review ▸ Network; it was under Window. It is also in the right-click Review menu.
  • A playlist on a network drive no longer slows the window. Whether each clip's file is there is checked in the background.
  • Locate Media… reads a folder in the background. A line above the toolbar says how far it has got.

Asobi Review 1.0 (build 1573) Oct 14, 2026

  • No color error on an offline clip. Going to a conformed clip whose footage isn't there showed "Color probe failed" over its Footage Offline card. The color check now leaves an offline clip alone.
  • Camera originals from your folders, even when the cut links camera files. A cut conformed against camera files on another drive (the studio server) took those files as the originals and never looked in the camera folders you chose. If the camera folders hold the same file, with the cut’s timecode inside it, plates now come from there.
  • Finishing v002. A plate an earlier pull began and didn’t finish was marked “Taken up again”. It now says which version this pull finishes, and its tooltip says how to start a new one instead.

Asobi Review 1.0 (build 1568) Oct 14, 2026

  • Frame by frame through a conformed cut. The arrow keys go on from a clip's last frame into the next event, and back from its first into the one before, as an edit application does. A layer stacked over a shot (V2 and up) is no longer the next clip shown when stepping, playing on or going to the next clip; click it in the Conform window to see it.
  • Footage Offline. A conformed clip whose footage isn't there shows a Footage Offline card with its name and Record TC, for as long as the cut holds it, instead of the clip before it.
  • RETIME ≈. A quiet pill beside the clip's name says when its retime plays only approximately: a ramp, played at its average speed.
  • Where each plate came from. Pull Plates writes plates/main/source_info.txt in either folder layout, as vfx edit commit does, and each line and the shot's conform text now also give the clip as the cut names it (its scene and take) and the Source TC the cut uses.
